decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake system extends the firm's established coating offer and took real development effort, and one year of results is too early to rule out temporary causes, so management will persist even though the website gives it only a mention.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the core business and is publicly committed on its own web page, so dropping it would write off investment and need justification.
A multi-model transfer pump line represents a substantial investment that builds on the established offer, which makes management reluctant to abandon it so soon after launch.
Fire protection flow monitoring is visibly presented on its own page and fits the announced digitalization direction, so any weak early results would likely be attributed to market ramp-up.
